title: Prepare experimental tensile strength data
action: Extract the filler volume fraction (phi_f) and relative tensile strength (sigma_R) from the four reference papers (chitosan/MWCNT, polysilsesquioxane/MWCNT, PVA/MWCNT, PET/MWCNT) into structured tables for model fitting.
description: Required data extraction step. The agent must obtain the numerical (phi_f, sigma_R) pairs from the public literature used in the paper. The succeeding fitting step depends on this data.

title: Fit Pukanszky model and compute B parameters
action: Implement the Pukanszky model. For chitosan/MWCNT and polysilsesquioxane/MWCNT, compute B_max using the known formula with CNT radius R=15 nm and matrix strengths (69.1 MPa and 75 MPa, respectively). Fit ln(sigma_Reduced) vs phi_f to obtain B via linear regression. Set B_I = B_max, B_N = B - B_max. For PVA/MWCNT and PET/MWCNT, fit B similarly and set B_I = B_N = B/2. Output all computed quantities as specified.
description: Produce a JSON file containing the fitted B, B_max, B_I, B_N for each of the four composite samples.
output_schema: JSON object with keys chitosan, polysilsesquioxane, PVA, PET. Each value is an object with numeric fields: B, B_max, B_I, B_N.

title: Parametric sweep of B_N and relative strength with aspect ratio and network density
action: Using the derived expressions for B_N and sigma_R (with B_I=10), evaluate over a grid: aspect ratio alpha from 100 to 1000 step 100, network density N from 100 to 500 step 100. Fixed parameters: phi_f=0.02, sigma_m=40 MPa, sigma_N=40 GPa. Write CSV with columns alpha, N, B_N, sigma_R.
description: Generate a CSV containing the computed B_N and sigma_R for each (alpha, N) combination, reproducing the parametric dependence in the paper.
output_schema: CSV with columns: alpha (integer), N (integer), B_N (float), sigma_R (float). One row per (alpha, N) combination.

title: Parametric sweep of B_N and relative strength with percolation threshold and network strength
action: Using the derived expressions for B_N and sigma_R (with B_I=10), evaluate over a grid: percolation threshold phi_p from 0.001 to 0.005 step 0.001, network strength sigma_N from 20 to 60 GPa step 10. Fixed parameters: phi_f=0.02, sigma_m=40 MPa, N=300. Write CSV with columns phi_p, sigma_N, B_N, sigma_R.
description: Generate a CSV containing the computed B_N and sigma_R for each (phi_p, sigma_N) combination, reproducing the parametric dependence in the paper.
output_schema: CSV with columns: phi_p (float), sigma_N (float), B_N (float), sigma_R (float). One row per (phi_p, sigma_N) combination.
